changelog:
Initial release of LYGO Lattice Birth — masked human identity, privacy-first lineage, and secure birth protocol for the Haven Star Chart.

- Enables creation of immutable, privacy-preserving human identities with masked public IDs and steward-only private anchors.
- Supports family lineage and joining via HMAC-based bind proofs without exposing real names or PII on the public chart.
- Integrates tightly with the lygo-haven-star-chart for secure birth submissions and lineage cosmology.
- Enforces strict consent, read/write, and subprocess controls; all live submissions require explicit human approval.
- Provides agent alignment training and supporting documentation for correct, secure usage.
